correctness.rationale: For Poisson anchors z>0 and independent stationary Brownian motions with fixed individual Poisson-reset rates R whose density f(r)~c r^a (a> -1/2), conditional no-reset covariance and Gaussian integration give fixed-r kernel F(h)=(3-h^2)Phi(-h)+h phi(h). Campbell law yields H(t)=rho sqrt(D)/4 E[R^(-1/2)F(sqrt(2Rt))] and permanent mark-disorder covariance plateau Vinf=rho sqrt(D)E[R^(-1/2)]/8. Mellin substitution and dominated convergence give H(t)~K_a t^(-a-1/2) with K_a=rho c sqrt(D)Gamma(a+1)(4a+5)/(2sqrt(pi)(2a+1)(2a+3)). Integrating 2/T^2 int_0^T (T-t)H(t)dt yields power, log(T)/T critical at a=1/2, and T^-1 above with coefficient 7rho sqrt(D)E[R^-3/2]/16. Independent numerical Mellin integrals at six exponents straddling a=.5 reproduce constants. No claim of CLT or quenched almost-sure rate.
